newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreigners biggest yen bond buyers in June -- JSDA.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners biggest yen bond buyers in June -- JSDA.

text.p: Foreign investors continued to be the biggest buyers of yen bonds in June, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said on Tuesday.
It said foreigners' net yen bond purchases in the month totalled 2.7832 trillion yen, up from 2.5484 trillion in May.
Foreigners' purchases of short-term bonds, totalling 2.7444 trillion yen, accounted for most of their yen bond buying.
The figures include Japanese government bonds, notes and Treasury bills, corporate bonds and bank debentures, the JSDA said.
